mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.store_id, st.name AS store_name, p.name AS product_name, p.image_url AS product_image, s.spec_name AS sku_spec, s.price AS price, c.quantity, c.create_time FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id LEFT JOIN store st ON c.store_id = st.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.store_id, st.name AS store_name, p.name AS product_name, p.image_url AS product_image, s.spec_name AS sku_spec, s.price AS price, c.quantity, c.create_time FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id LEFT JOIN store st ON c.store_id = st.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.store_id, st.name AS store_name, p.name AS product_name, p.image_url AS product_image, s.spec_name AS sku_spec, s.price AS price, c.quantity, c.create_time FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id LEFT JOIN store st ON c.store_id = st.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.store_id = #{storeId} AND c.product_id = #{productId} AND (#{skuId} IS NULL OR c.sku_id = #{skuId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item(user_id, store_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES(#{userId}, #{storeId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})

INSERT INTO cart_item(user_id, store_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES(#{userId}, #{storeId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity)
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
